prompt: Ruth keeps losing study time when a friend messages mid-session. Which if-then plan is strongest for this specific obstacle?

options.text: 'If a message arrives during my 25-minute block, then I will note it on paper and reply at the break'
'If I feel tempted, then I will be more disciplined'
'If my friend messages, then she should know better'
'If I study well this week, then I will treat myself on Sunday'

explanation: The strongest plan names the exact obstacle as the cue and a small, doable response in that moment. Vague resolve and plans about other people do not control her next action.
